scripts.dev: npm run build -w packages/shared-types && npm run build -w apps/mcp-server && node scripts/kill-dev-ports.mjs && node apps/mcp-server/dist/start-project-manager.js --dev
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared-types && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/mcp-server && npm run build -w apps/windows-importer && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build -w packages/shared-types && npm run db:migrate -w apps/api
scripts.test: npm run test -w apps/api && npm run test -w apps/mcp-server && npm run test -w apps/windows-importer
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w apps/web && npm run lint -w apps/api
